samples.question: What is the cancellation policy?
samples.answer: You may cancel an order without charge at any time before the Seller accepts the order. Once the order is accepted, you cannot cancel it. Orders may be canceled for reasons such as shortage or unavailability of products, force majeure events, nonavailability of services, unforeseen circumstances, delivery-related issues, or concerns regarding fraudulent activity or non-compliance with the terms. If a cancellation is accepted, you will not be charged and will receive a refund for any payment made as early as practically possible.
